Real Loader positive control succeeds; all positive graph mains are callable before any lazy evaluation starts.

trace: Initialize main and issue left/right imports.
Witness both IDs active on one shared dependency gate.
Release and verify branch state sharing and dependency-before-branch order.
contract.stress: Two branch modules share one suspended leaf.
contract.oracle: One shared-start/ready; one each branch-ready; unique counts1,2 from same leaf object.

contract.overlap: same-request overlap of two actual loaded-worker invocations
